title: Backup
description: Create a downloadable snapshot of the platform: database, uploaded files, installed skills and (when available) the vector store. Backups are stored on the server and can be downloaded or deleted here.
note: Redis (queue/cache) is transient and is not included. Restoring a backup is a command-line/ops task.
deleteConfirm: Delete this backup? This cannot be undone.

host.title: Scheduled backups
host.description: On the schedule (default: every night at 02:15) a full snapshot (database, user files, skills, vectors, configuration) goes to the chosen destination; with continuous WAL archiving you can go back to any moment, not only to the last snapshot. The work is done by scripts/backup.sh on the server (root's cron): here you set the rules and see the state.
host.neverRan: No run recorded yet: on the server, install the job with
host.loadError: Cannot read the state of the scheduled backups.
host.problemDest: Destination unreachable at the last check ({{when}}). WAL stays in the local spool up to its limit.
host.problemGap: Gap in the WAL archive from segment {{seg}} (spool full): point-in-time recovery resumes from the next base backup, taken automatically as soon as the destination is back.
host.pendingOn: WAL archiving requested but not active yet: the job on the server applies it within a minute (Postgres restarts for a few seconds). If it stays like this, check the cron is installed.
host.pendingOff: WAL archiving to be turned off: the job on the server applies it within a minute (Postgres restarts for a few seconds).
host.walArchivingHint: Postgres archives every change (at most every 5 minutes) and takes a base backup once a week: the database can be restored to any moment covered. It also covers the other databases on the same Postgres. Switching it on or off restarts Postgres for a few seconds.
host.destLocalHint: The folder is set in the server's .env (HOST_BACKUP_DIR, also a mounted network share): a server path is not chosen from here. If unset: ./backups on the same disk as the data.
host.destNetworkHint: Network share with a username and password: the server uses it directly, without mounting it. The password is encrypted in the database; the folder is created if missing.
host.saved: Saved. The job on the server uses the new settings from its next round.
host.testWriteFail: Connected, but cannot write in the folder (does it exist? permissions?): {{error}}
host.alertHint: Alarms by webhook (HOST_BACKUP_ALERT_WEBHOOK in .env): {{state}}. They are listed below in any case.
host.scheduleCron: Cron expression (minute hour day month weekday)
host.scheduleHint: Server local time, at most once an hour; applies from the minute after saving. Expression:
